annotations.text:
FarmsyncSolver — retro directions
Same moment in all three: a run mid-round, 87 of 132 done.
Real app wording throughout. Pick one and I build Settings, Setup, the close question, and the NiceGUI theme to match.

A — Beveled desktop
Grey face, raised buttons, sunken panels. Reads as a serious little Windows tool.
Tradeoff: the most familiar, so the least memorable. Cheapest to build in NiceGUI.

B — Amber terminal
CRT phosphor, scanlines, one monospace face. Fits an app that watches a machine work.
Tradeoff: long sessions on amber tire the eyes, and dense data gets cramped.

C — Inked paper
1-bit ink on warm paper, hard shadows, pixel labels. The boldest of the three.
Tradeoff: heavy borders eat space in a 900x640 window, and the table gets tight.
